statement: Exact convergent global pro-three presentation and sufficient coupled local-packet gluing, with actual Frobenius words, all geometric conjugations, rational descent, and a finite obstruction to independent local Frobenius coordinates.
manuscript_passages: Section51.16, folios733v–736v, scans172–178, formulas371–379; Part E(c),(d), follow-up(4)
notes: The source is the actual maximal pro-three quotient of G_K for K=Q(zeta3); cocycles from the full arithmetic group factor through it by their pro-three semidirect target. Rational descent retains the actual conjugation words.
Continuous H2 is the direct sum over good primes, whereas the compact relation module is its product dual. The chosen inertia generators and local relators converge to the identity.
Wingberg Lemma1.1 and its preceding bundle definition are reduced explicitly using coinduced modules, finite support, and the positive local transgression evaluation.

The actual local Frobenius words normally generate the complete relation ideal together with their inertia generators. Their evaluated local packet equations are sufficient; no additional relation remains after those evaluations.
The equations are coupled. The actual Kummer quotient over seven and nineteen gives a finite witness against replacing Frobenius evaluation by the quotient-section value.

This is an exact transfer and presentation, not an evaluation of all higher Frobenius words or a solution of every coupled global equation. The outstanding global classification retains that arithmetic input.
